method.native_best_rule: Completed grades; grounding >=3; highest total; stable recorded rank breaks ties. Audit acceptance is separate.
method.acceptance_rule: Completed grades; grounding >=3; quality audit clear or minor_issues.
method.mean_rule: No zero imputation for missing candidates, scores or unrun modes. All-candidate means weight questions; best means weight eligible documents.
method.v4_prompt_scope: UN practitioner generation and quality plus UN faithfulness v4; Jev remains Revised v2. Other generation/quality prompts remain Revised v2.
limitations: Native verifiers differ across variants; score changes are not causal estimates of quality or verifier accuracy.
v4 ran only the selected mode; no current lookup observations or best-mode accuracy estimate.
Candidate counts vary; choosing the best of a larger batch can change best-candidate means.
The old all-mode sample attempts 50 documents per mode; v4 attempts44 practitioner and6 semantic. Matched-cohort tables address that coverage difference.
Historical manual review covered20 UN documents and did not include v4. The v4 four-question spot check is not comparable to that review.

v4_spot_check.scope: All four questions from the first three completed practitioner targets in saved selection order.
v4_spot_check.source: Exact source payloads in selection.json and questions in the run outcomes.

findings.assessment: Relevant State/programme-adoption case, but no identifying period. Asking what States should consider partly repeats the adoption premise; substantive programme features remain a useful unknown. Answer is target-supported.

National drug-strategy task is plausible, but the question locates a dated General Assembly resolution and asks what it reaffirmed. This conflicts with the practitioner rule against descriptive document locators. Answer is target-supported.

Liaison-officer briefing largely wraps a source-comprehension question in a professional role and locates the dated resolution. Little of the case determines the requested point. Answer is target-supported.

Mapping institutional partners is plausible, but the question relies on a dated resolution locator and does not identify Francophonie cooperation through the situation itself. Answer is target-supported.

v4_spot_check.summary: All four answers preserve source status and are supported by their target blocks. Three questions still use prohibited descriptive document locators; several roles function mainly as prefaces to lookup questions. These counts describe this small spot check only.
